title: The overtaking rejection
summary: An acceptance is mailed before a rejection, but the rejection reaches the offeror first.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

When did acceptance take effect under the invited medium? Does the rejection explain that an acceptance is in transit? Did the offeror rely on the earlier-arriving rejection? The commentary raises estoppel; do not turn the example into a blanket rule that the first communication received always controls.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
